title: Launcher Options
desc: Running the app for different scenarios.
lede: The launchers cover everyday running and a few special cases via flags.
body:
At a glance
  • run.sh / run.ps1 flags.
  • A generic plugin setup loop.
  • Port and reload control.

Flags

  • --setup-only — provision without starting.
  • --no-reload — disable the dev auto-reload.
  • --port <n> — change the port (default 8123).

Setup loop

The launcher provisions the app and engine environments and installs plugin dependencies the first time. See Launcher Scripts.
